units.title: Introduction & Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
topics: Definitions and Core Philosophies of Artificial Intelligence: Thinking Humanly vs Rationally
Historical Evolution of AI: Dartmouth Workshop (1956), AI Winters, Expert Systems Boom & Modern Deep Learning
Philosophical Foundations of AI: Mind-Body Dualism, Materialism & Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (PSSH)
Alan Turing's Imitation Game: The Turing Test, Loopholes, Total Turing Test & Loebner Prize
John Searle's Chinese Room Thought Experiment: Syntax vs Semantics, Strong AI vs Weak AI Critique
Symbolic AI (GOFAI) vs Connectionist AI: Logic-Based Manipulation vs Neural Networks & Distributed Representations
Concept of Intelligent Agents: Definition, Agent Function, Agent Program, Sensors, Actuators & Environment Interaction
PEAS Framework: Performance Measure, Environment, Actuators, Sensors Characterization for Autonomous Agents
Environment Categorization: Fully vs Partially Observable, Deterministic vs Stochastic, Episodic vs Sequential
Agent Architecture Taxonomies: Simple Reflex Agents, Model-Based Reflex Agents, Goal-Based Agents & Utility-Based Agents
Learning Agents Framework: Critic, Learning Element, Learning Goals & Performance Element
Ethical Considerations and Future of AI: Algorithmic Bias, Autonomous Decision Making & Safety Alignment

units.title: AI Problem Solving & State Space Search Techniques
topics: Problem Solving as State Space Search: Initial State, State Space Graph, Transition Model, Goal State & Path Cost
Production Systems Architecture: Working Memory, Production Rules (Condition-Action), Inference Engine & Conflict Resolution
Control Strategies & Problem Characteristics: Modularity, Recoverability, Predictability & Knowledge Necessity
Uninformed Search Strategies: Breadth-First Search (BFS) Algorithm, Completeness, Time & Space Complexity (O(b^d))
Depth-First Search (DFS) & Depth-Limited Search (DLS): Algorithm, Backtracking Mechanism & Memory Efficiency (O(bm))
Iterative Deepening Search (IDS) & Uniform Cost Search (Dijkstra-Variant): Optimality and Trade-offs
Informed (Heuristic) Search: Heuristic Functions h(n), Admissibility Condition (h(n) <= h*(n)) & Consistency/Monotonicity
Greedy Best-First Search: Evaluation Function f(n) = h(n), Greedy Traversal & Susceptibility to Local Extrema
A* Search Algorithm: f(n) = g(n) + h(n), Mathematical Proof of Optimality on Tree and Graph Searches
Local Search & Optimization: Pure Hill Climbing, Steepest-Ascent, Stochastic Hill Climbing, Foothills, Plateaus & Ridges
Problem Reduction & AND/OR Graphs: AO* Search Algorithm, Branching, Futility & Hyper-Arcs
Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP): Backtracking Search, Constraint Propagation & Forward Checking
Adversarial Search & Game Playing: Two-Player Zero-Sum Games, Minimax Decision Rule, Backup Values
Alpha-Beta Pruning: Alpha Cutoffs, Beta Cutoffs, Optimal Move Ordering & Effective Branching Factor Reduction

units.title: Knowledge Representation & Classical Logic
topics: Knowledge Representation Requirements: Representational Adequacy, Inferential Adequacy, Inferential Efficiency & Acquisitional Efficiency
Propositional Logic: Syntax, Semantics, Truth Tables, Logical Connectives, Validity, Satisfiability & Tautologies
First-Order Predicate Logic (FOPL): Universal (∀) and Existential (∃) Quantifiers, Predicates, Terms, Functions & Arity
Conversion to Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF): 9-Step Standard Procedure (Eliminating Implications, De Morgan's, Skolemization)
Skolemization Paradigm: Skolem Constants vs Skolem Functions for Existential Quantifiers
Clause Form Transformation: Prenex Normal Form, Eliminating Universal Quantifiers & Dropping Conjunctions
Unification Algorithm in FOPL: Most General Unifier (MGU), Substitution Sets & Occur Check Implementation
Resolution Refutation Principle: J. Alan Robinson's Rule of Inference, Proof by Contradiction in Clause Logic
Resolution Refutation Trees: Linear Resolution, Binary Resolution & Resolvent Construction
Deduction, Induction, and Abduction: Formal Distinctions, Defeasible Reasoning & Soundness
Automated Theorem Proving: Robinson's Algorithm Application to Mathematical & Logical Proofs
Question Answering Systems: Green's Method, Answer Literals, Binding Accumulation & Extracting Variable Substitutions

units.title: Reasoning Techniques & Structured Knowledge Representation
topics: Forward Chaining (Data-Driven Reasoning): Modus Ponens Execution, Cycle of Matching, Activation & Firing
Backward Chaining (Goal-Driven Reasoning): Hypothesis Testing, Sub-Goal Decomposition & Stack-Based Processing
Conflict Resolution Strategies: Specificity Rule, Recency Principle, Priority Order & Refractoriness
Pattern Matching Paradigms: Rete Matching Algorithm, Alpha Networks, Beta Memory & Discrimination Trees
Indexing Schemes for Large Knowledge Bases: Content-Addressable Indexing, Hash-Indexed Rules & Discrimination Trees
Semantic Networks: Quillian's Model, Nodes, Labeled Directed Edges, ISA and AKO Hierarchies, Property Inheritance
Exception Handling in Semantic Nets: Overriding Defaults, Multiple Inheritance Conflicts & Diamond Problem
Frames Representation (Marvin Minsky): Frame Structure, Slots, Fillers, Facets, Default Values, Demonic Triggers (if-needed, if-added)
Conceptual Dependency (CD) Theory (Roger Schank): Primitive Acts (ATRANS, PTRANS, MTRANS, MBUILD, INGEST, EXPEL, MOVE, GRASP)
CD Conceptual Roles: Actor, Objective, Recipient, Directive & Conceptual Tenses
Scripts Knowledge Representation: Schank's Scripts, Causal Chains, Restaurant Script Standard Paradigm
Components of Scripts: Entry Conditions, Props, Roles, Tracks & Scenes Progression

units.title: AI Applications, Expert Systems & Natural Language Processing
topics: Introduction to Expert Systems: Definition, Domain Specificity, Human Expert vs AI Expert Comparison
Architecture of Expert Systems: Knowledge Base, Inference Engine, Working Memory, User Interface & Explanation Facility
Knowledge Acquisition Process: Knowledge Engineers, Domain Experts, Protocol Analysis & Elicitation Bottleneck
Explanation Subsystem: 'How' Explanations (Sub-goal Trees) and 'Why' Explanations (Rule Tracing)
Rule-Based Expert Systems: MYCIN (Infectious Diseases Diagnosis, Certainty Factors CF), DENDRAL & PROSPECTOR Case Studies
Certainty Factor Theory: Measures of Belief (MB), Measures of Disbelief (MD), Combining Evidence in MYCIN
Expert System Shells: Architecture, CLIPS, JESS, Separation of Domain Knowledge from Inference Mechanisms
Natural Language Processing (NLP) Overview: Communication Pipeline, Ambiguity Challenges (Lexical, Syntactic, Semantic, Pragmatic)
Morphological Analysis & Tokenization: Stems, Roots, Affixes, Lemmatization vs Porter Stemmer Algorithm
Syntactic Analysis: Context-Free Grammars (CFG), Parse Trees, Top-Down vs Bottom-Up Parsing, Cocke-Younger-Kasami (CYK)
Semantic Analysis & Pragmatics: Compositional Semantics, Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD), Discourse Analysis & Reference Resolution
Contemporary AI Paradigms: Introduction to Machine Learning (Supervised, Unsupervised, RL), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), SVM & Fuzzy Logic Basics

units.title: Web Basics, HTML5, CSS3 & Client-Side JavaScript

HTML Form Elements & Layout Controls: Lists (<ol>, <ul>, <dl>), Tables (<thead>, <tbody>, rowspan, colspan), Forms (<input>, <select>, <textarea>)

CSS Integration Paradigms: Inline Styles, Internal Stylesheets (<style>), External Stylesheets (<link rel='stylesheet'>)
CSS Box Model: Content, Padding, Border, Margin, box-sizing Property, Flexbox & CSS Grid Basics

JavaScript Functions & Scope: Function Declarations, Function Expressions, Arrow Functions, Lexical Scope, Closures
DOM Manipulation & Event Handling: Document Object Model, getElementById, querySelector, Event Listeners (onclick, onsubmit, onchange)
Client-Side Form Validation: Regular Expressions (Regex), Real-Time Field Feedback, preventDefault() & Sanitization

units.title: XML Technologies & Server-Side PHP Programming

Document Type Definition (DTD): Internal vs External DTD, Elements, Attributes (CDATA, ID, IDREF), Entities
XML Schemas (XSD): Data Typing, Schema Definition, Complex Types vs Simple Types, Namespaces
Presenting XML: Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL), XSL Transformations (XSLT), XPath Expressions
XHTML: Strict, Transitional & Frameset Specifications, Differences Between HTML and XHTML Syntax

PHP Server-Side Architecture: PHP Engine, Server Interaction (Apache/Nginx mod_php), <?php ... ?> Tagging
PHP Language Primitives: Variables ($ prefix), Dynamic Typing, Constants, Arithmetic, Logical and Bitwise Operators
PHP Control Structures: Conditional Statements (if-else, switch-case), Iterative Loops (for, while, do-while, foreach)
PHP Arrays: Indexed Arrays, Associative Arrays, Multidimensional Arrays, Array Manipulation Functions
PHP Functions & Parameter Mechanisms: User-Defined Functions, Default Arguments, Pass by Value vs Pass by Reference (&)
PHP Superglobals & Form Handling: $_GET, $_POST, $_REQUEST, $_SERVER, Form Data Sanitization (htmlspecialchars, strip_tags)

units.title: Web Servers, Java Servlet Architecture & Session Management
topics: Web Servers Overview: Apache Tomcat, Web Server vs Application Server, Java Servlet Development Kit (JSDK)
Servlet Architecture: Java Servlet Specification, Advantages over CGI (Multithreading, Platform Independence, Persistence)
Servlet Lifecycle: Class Loading, Instantiation, init() Initialization, service() Dispatch, destroy() Cleanup

HttpServletResponse Interface: Setting MIME Content-Type, Character Encoding, Headers, Status Codes & PrintWriter Output
Servlet Initialization & Context: Reading ServletConfig init-parameters, ServletContext Application-Wide Parameters
State Management in Web Applications: Stateless Nature of HTTP Protocol, Challenges in Multi-Step Workflows
Cookies API: Creating Cookies, Setting Max-Age, Path, Domain, Secure and HttpOnly Flags, Client-Side Storage
HttpSession Interface: Session Tracking, Session ID (JSESSIONID), URL Rewriting, getSession(boolean), Session Invalidation & Timeouts

units.title: Database Access with JDBC, PHP-MySQL & MVC Frameworks
topics: Database Access in Web Applications: Two-Tier vs Three-Tier Architecture, Persistence Layer Principles

Executing Database Queries in PHP: Establishing Connection, Prepared Statements (bind_param, execute), Fetching Associative Rows
Model-View-Controller (MVC) Pattern: Separation of Concerns, Model (Business Logic), View (Presentation), Controller (Flow)
Apache Struts Framework: Architecture, ActionServlet (Front Controller), ActionForm, Action Class, struts-config.xml Workflow

units.title: JavaServer Pages (JSP) & JavaBean Architecture
topics: Introduction to JavaServer Pages (JSP): JSP Motivation, Comparison of Servlets vs JSP Pages, Separation of Roles
JSP Page Anatomy & Lifecycle: Translation Phase (JSP to Servlet Source), Compilation Phase (.class), Instantiation, _jspInit, _jspService, _jspDestroy

JSP Standard Action Elements: <jsp:include> (Dynamic Inclusion vs Directive Static Inclusion), <jsp:forward>, <jsp:param>
JavaBeans Architecture: JavaBean Specification, Zero-Argument Constructor, Private Properties, Getters and Setters, Serializable
Deploying JavaBeans in JSP: <jsp:useBean> Tag, Scope Attributes (page, request, session, application)
Setting and Getting Bean Properties: <jsp:setProperty name='...' property='*'/> Automapping, <jsp:getProperty>
JSP Expression Language (EL): Syntax (${expression}), Implicit Objects (param, header, cookie), Operators, Simplifying Data Access
JSTL (JSP Standard Tag Library): Core Tags (<c:out>, <c:set>, <c:if>, <c:forEach>, <c:choose>), Formatting & SQL Tags
Security & Performance Optimization in JSP: Preventing XSS Attacks, Disabling Scriptlets, Custom Error Pages & Caching Strategies

units.title: Introduction to Computer Graphics, Hardware & Display Devices
topics: History and Evolution of Computer Graphics: Whirlwind Computer, Sketchpad (Ivan Sutherland), Evolution to GPU-Driven Real-Time Rendering

units.title: Scan Conversion Algorithms for Primitives & Curves

Properties of Bezier Curves: Affine Invariance, Convex Hull Property, Endpoint Interpolation, Tangency Condition, Variation Diminishing Property

Bezier Surfaces: Tensor Product Bezier Patches, Control Net, Evaluation and Surface Rendering

Properties of B-Splines: Local Control, Knot Vectors (Uniform, Open Uniform, Non-Uniform), Non-Uniform Rational B-Splines (NURBS) Overview

Animation Software Tools & Workflows: Blender, Maya, Unity, Production Pipeline (Pre-production, Production, Post-production Compositing)

units.title: Introduction to Cyber Security, Cyberspace & Threats
topics: Introduction to Cyber Security: Definition, Scope, Need for Security in Digitized Society & Economic Impacts

Access Control Principles: Subject, Object, Principle of Least Privilege, Separation of Duties & Defense in Depth

Overview of Malicious Software (Malware): Viruses, Worms, Trojan Horses, Spyware, Adware, Ransomware & Rootkits
Social Engineering Attacks: Phishing (Spear, Whaling), Pretexting, Baiting, Vishing, Smishing & Human Exploitation Vectors

units.title: Classes of Security Attacks & Security Models
topics: Taxonomy of Security Attacks: Passive Attacks (Eavesdropping, Traffic Analysis) vs Active Attacks (Masquerade, Replay, Modification, Denial of Service)
Network-Level Attacks: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM), ARP Spoofing, DNS Cache Poisoning, IP Spoofing & Session Hijacking

Application-Level Attacks: SQL Injection (SQLi), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS - Stored, Reflected, DOM-Based), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

Impact of Cyber Attacks: Financial Losses, Reputational Damage, Operational Disruptions, Legal Penalties & Critical Infrastructure Failures

Classic Security Models: Bell-LaPadula Model (Confidentiality: No Read Up, No Write Down), Biba Model (Integrity: No Read Down, No Write Up)
Commercial Security Models: Clark-Wilson Model (Well-Formed Transactions, Separation of Duties), Chinese Wall Model (Conflict of Interest)
The CIA Triad: Core Tenets, Mutual Trade-offs, Availability vs Confidentiality Tensions in High-Speed Computing
The Star Model: Comprehensive Interlocking Framework for Cyber Security Strategy and Risk Governance
The Parkerian Hexad (Donn Parker): Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Authenticity, Possession/Control, and Utility Extensions

units.title: Cyber Security Policy, Governance & Stakeholders

Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS): In-Line Traffic Filtering, Automated Rule Enforcement, Honeypots & Decoy Systems

Cyber Hygiene Best Practices: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Password Managers, Secure Backup 3-2-1 Rule, Safe Browsing Habits

units.title: .NET Framework Architecture & Visual Basic Language Primitives
topics: Overview of Microsoft .NET Framework: Motivation, Evolution from COM/Win32, Multi-Language Integration Paradigm
.NET Architecture: Common Language Runtime (CLR), Just-In-Time (JIT) Compilers (Pre-JIT, Normal JIT, Econo-JIT)
Code Loading and Execution Process: Source Code Compilation to Microsoft Intermediate Language (MSIL), Metadata, Assembly (.dll / .exe)
Common Type System (CTS): Value Types (Primitive, Enum, Struct) vs Reference Types (Class, Interface, Array, Delegate)
Common Language Specification (CLS): Rules for Cross-Language Interoperability, Cross-Language Inheritance
Event-Driven Programming Paradigm: Event Queue, Event Handlers, Delegates as Type-Safe Function Pointers
Visual Studio 2010 IDE Architecture: Solution Explorer, Toolbox, Properties Window, Code Editor, Output & Error List Windows
Introduction to Visual Basic (.NET): Syntax Structure, Statements, Comments, Case-Insensitivity
VB Data Types, Variables & Constants: Primitive Data Types (Integer, Double, String, Boolean, Date), Dim, Static, Const
Type Conversion Mechanisms: Implicit vs Explicit Conversion, CType, DirectCast, CBool, CInt, CStr Functions, Parse and TryParse
Operators & Control Statements: Arithmetic, Relational, Logical Operators, If...Then...ElseIf...End If, Select Case Selection
Looping Structures, Arrays & Procedures: For...Next, For Each...Next, Do While/Until, Single/Multidimensional Arrays, Sub vs Function, ByVal vs ByRef

units.title: Windows Forms, Controls, Menus & Exception Handling
topics: Windows Forms Architecture: System.Windows.Forms Namespace, Form Lifecycle (Load, Activated, Shown, Closing, Closed)
Basic Form Controls: Label, TextBox, Button, CheckBox, RadioButton, GroupBox, Panel - Properties, Methods and Events
List and Selection Controls: ListBox, ComboBox, CheckedListBox (Items Collection, SelectedIndex, SelectedItem)
Advanced Visual Controls: PictureBox, Timer Control (Tick Event, Interval), ProgressBar, TrackBar, ScrollBars (HScrollBar, VScrollBar)
Hierarchical & Tabular Data Controls: ListView (LargeIcon, SmallIcon, Details, Columns), TreeView (TreeNode, AfterSelect Event)
Navigation & Layout Controls: ToolStrip, StatusStrip, MenuStrip, ContextMenuStrip, FlowLayoutPanel, TableLayoutPanel
Standard Common Dialog Boxes: OpenFileDialog, SaveFileDialog, FontDialog, ColorDialog, PrintDialog (ShowDialog, Filter Property)
Designing Professional Menus: Menu Strip, Access Keys (& prefix), Shortcut Keys, Checked Items, Context Menus
Major Error Categories: Compile-Time (Syntax) Errors, Runtime (Execution) Errors, Logical (Semantic) Errors
Structured Exception Handling in .NET: Try...Catch...Finally Blocks, Filtering Exceptions (Catch ex As FormatException)
User-Defined Custom Exceptions: Inheriting from System.Exception Class, Throwing Custom Exceptions with Meaningful Messages
Visual Studio Debugging Techniques: Setting Breakpoints, Step Into (F11), Step Over (F10), Watch Window, Immediate Window, Call Stack

units.title: Object-Oriented Programming & Class Libraries in .NET
topics: Object-Oriented Programming Principles in .NET: Abstraction, Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism
Class and Object Definition: Class Declaration, Object Instantiation (New Keyword), Class Members (Fields, Properties, Methods, Events)
Constructors and Destructors: Sub New Constructor, Parameterized Constructors, Constructor Overloading, Finalize and Dispose Pattern
Property Procedures in VB: Private Backing Fields, Property...Get...Set...End Property, Auto-Implemented Properties
Inheritance Mechanisms: Single Inheritance, Inherits Keyword, MustInherit (Abstract Classes), NotInheritable (Sealed Classes)
Method Overloading vs Method Overriding: Overloads Keyword (Compile-Time Polymorphism), Overrides and Overridable Keywords (Runtime Polymorphism)
MyBase and MyClass Keywords: Invoking Base Class Constructors and Methods, Resolving Member Shadowing
Interfaces in .NET: Interface Declaration, Implements Keyword, Multiple Interface Implementation, Standard Interfaces (IComparable, IDisposable)
Access Modifiers in .NET: Public, Private, Protected, Friend (Internal), Protected Friend Scope Semantics
Namespaces in .NET: Organizing Types, Namespace...End Namespace, Imports Statement, Preventing Class Naming Collisions
Delegates and Events: Declaring Delegates, Delegate Sub/Function, Event Keyword, RaiseEvent, AddHandler and RemoveHandler
Creating and Consuming Class Libraries: Class Library Project (.dll), Compiling Reusable Assemblies, Adding Project References

units.title: ADO.NET Architecture & Database Connectivity
topics: Introduction to ADO.NET: Motivation, Evolution from Classic ADO, XML Integration, Disconnected Architecture Paradigm
ADO.NET Architecture: Two Core Components - .NET Data Providers (Connected) and DataSet (Disconnected)
.NET Data Provider Core Objects: Connection (SqlConnection, OleDbConnection), Command (SqlCommand), DataReader, DataAdapter
Managing Database Connections: Connection Strings (Data Source, Initial Catalog, Integrated Security), Open(), Close(), Using Statement
Executing Database Commands: SqlCommand Object, CommandType (Text, StoredProcedure), ExecuteNonQuery(), ExecuteScalar(), ExecuteReader()
Fast Forward-Only Data Access: SqlDataReader, Read() Method, Type-Safe Column Access, Minimal Memory Footprint
Disconnected Data Architecture: SqlDataAdapter, Fill() Method, Update() Method, SqlCommandBuilder for Automated SQL Generation
In-Memory Database Hierarchy: DataSet, DataTableCollection, DataTable, DataColumn, DataRow, DataRelation
Data Table Operations: Adding Rows (NewRow(), Rows.Add()), Modifying Rows, Row States (Added, Modified, Deleted, Unchanged)
Filtering and Sorting with DataView: DataView Object, RowFilter Expression, Sort Property, Binding to Controls
DataGridView Control: Architecture, Column Types (TextBox, ComboBox, Button, CheckBox), AutoGenerateColumns, Cell Formatting
Data Binding Paradigms: Simple Data Binding (Single Property), Complex Data Binding (DataSource, DataMember), BindingSource Component

units.title: ASP.NET 4.0 Web Forms & Application Deployment
topics: Introduction to ASP.NET 4.0: Web Architecture, Comparison of ASP.NET Web Forms vs Windows Forms (Stateless vs Stateful)
ASP.NET Web Applications Structure: Web Pages (.aspx), Code-Behind Files (.aspx.vb), App_Data, App_Code, Bin Folders
Benefits of ASP.NET Web Pages: Server Controls, Automatic ViewState Management, Event Model, Rapid Development
Configuration and Application Files: web.config Architecture (System.web, ConnectionStrings, AppSettings), global.asax Application Lifecycle
Thin-Client Architecture: Client-Side Browser Rendering vs Server-Side Processing Pipeline, Postback Mechanism (IsPostBack Property)
ASP.NET Standard Server Controls: Label, TextBox, Button, LinkButton, ImageButton, DropDownList, CheckBoxList, RadioButtonList
ASP.NET Validation Controls: RequiredFieldValidator, RangeValidator, CompareValidator, RegularExpressionValidator, CustomValidator, ValidationSummary
Site Layout and Navigation: Master Pages (.master), ContentPlaceHolder, Content Pages, SiteMapPath, Menu Control, TreeView Navigation
Themes and Skins: Theme Folders, Skin Files (.skin), Cascading Style Sheets, Applying Themes Programmatically and Statically
Data-Driven Web Pages with GridView: GridView Web Server Control, SqlDataSource Configuration, Paging, Sorting, In-Line Editing and Deleting
State Management in ASP.NET: Client-Side (ViewState, HiddenField, Cookies, QueryString) vs Server-Side (Session, Application, Cache)
Application Deployment Wizards: Publish Web Site Wizard, Creating Windows Installer (.msi) Setup Projects, Prerequisites, GAC Deployment
